records.name: m6-rice-plant-panicle-v1
records.prompt: Scientific educational natural history ink and watercolour plate for Year12 biology. One mature rice plant, Oryza sativa, a clump of several tillers from a single base, roots trimmed just below the base. Narrow upright green leaves and exactly three or four ripe golden tan branching panicles drooping under grain weight. One foreground panicle is prominent so individual husked grains read at 400 pixels tall. Rice grains attach along branching panicles, never a dense unbranched wheat ear. No water, paddy or soil block. Fine dark ink contours, rich but natural layered watercolour, realistic not cartoon, matching the drawing register of the reference rice and cotton. Transparent PNG with true alpha, clean edges with NO coloured fringe, halo, speckles, backdrop or glow. Square canvas final2000x2000, centred subject and at least12percent fully clear margin all sides. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, logos, people, hands or faces. No ground shadow. Supporting images are STYLE references only: do not copy their fringe defects or their subject.
records.processing: Keep connected components of at least 24 native pixels with alpha above 200. Erode two native pixels and soften by 0.35 pixel to remove coloured fringe. Retain object RGB, remove alpha below 8, then fit proportionally within 1560 pixels on a 2000-square canvas. Preserve native originals.
records.processingAuthorisation: Prior owner authorisation for deterministic alpha cleanup, proportional resizing and alignment, recorded in brief108-provenance.json and retained in brief111-provenance.json.
records.status: technical candidate, owner art acceptance pending
